title: Anthropic - Custom subagents
note: Subagent context, configuration and worktree isolation. Explicitly verify the intended base revision and installed-version behavior.

title: Anthropic - Extend Claude with skills
note: Repository-local skill conventions and progressive procedure loading.

title: Anthropic - Hooks reference
note: Lifecycle events, blocking feedback, stop-hook reentry and supported configuration. A hook is not an unlimited autonomous-session guarantee.

title: Anthropic - Agent SDK overview
note: Agent runtime versus direct client SDK; supported integrations, authentication and branding guidance. The documentation restricts unapproved third-party use of claude.ai login/rate limits.

title: Anthropic - Claude Code cloud
note: Cloud environments, isolation, network and session limitations. Published capability does not establish access in a specific session.

title: OpenAI - Codex SDK
note: Programmatic Codex integrations and current SDK/app-server guidance. At review the page states that legacy codex mcp-server commands have been removed; recheck before implementation.

title: OpenAI - Codex MCP
note: Connecting Codex clients to external stdio or Streamable HTTP MCP servers and authentication/configuration distinctions.

title: Model Context Protocol - Tools
note: Tool discovery, schemas, structured output and error semantics. Negotiate actual supported versions and capabilities.

title: Model Context Protocol - Authorization
note: Authorization requirements for supported network transports and client/server boundaries; local stdio has a different trust setup.

title: FFmpeg - Filters documentation
note: Building blocks for scaling/cropping/composition, overlays, timed filters, transitions, audio processing and subtitles. Availability depends on the actual build.

title: FFmpeg - ffprobe documentation
note: Machine-readable stream/container probing, metadata and timecode inspection.

title: FFmpeg - Command-line documentation
note: Input/output streams, mapping, transcoding, timing and hardware-related options. Probe actual host support rather than infer it from an option name.

title: SYSTRAN - faster-whisper repository
note: Primary project documentation for Whisper inference with CTranslate2, CPU/GPU profiles, int8 execution and timestamps. This package does not adopt repository benchmark claims as guaranteed performance.

title: SYSTRAN - faster-whisper-small model card
note: Multilingual converted small-model candidate and its license/configuration. Pin a tested revision and check real language/accuracy behavior.

title: Qwen - Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct model card
note: Primary candidate model card documenting image/video input support and license. No claim that it is the latest, universally best, or feasible on every CPU/GPU.

title: YouTube Help - Supported subtitle and closed-caption files
note: Supported caption-file types and limitations. Separate sidecar captions from burned text and container streams; verify current upload behavior when documenting platform instructions.

title: SciPy - scipy.signal.correlate
note: Cross-correlation and lag estimation primitives. Camera sync accuracy still requires evidence, ambiguity handling and real output tests.

title: DJI - DJI GO
note: Official DJI GO application description; does not identify the user's camera or prove its recording metadata/features.

title: Vite - Getting started
note: Current frontend starter/build documentation, including React/TypeScript templates. Pin compatible versions after environment inspection.

title: FastAPI - Background tasks
note: Distinction between lightweight response-associated work and heavier processing. A separate durable worker is this package's chosen architecture.

title: SQLite - Write-ahead logging
note: WAL concurrency/operational behavior and local-host/network-filesystem constraints relevant to the default persistence choice.
